metadata.title: Modern Country Album Cover with Line Art Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait against a solid warm background featuring white illustrative line art and bold, vertically stacked sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: burnt orange background with white line art
vertical display typography on left edge
excludeWhen: minimalist black and white photography is requested
classical or orchestral themes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man in a dark shirt and cap, positioned slightly off-center against a terracotta-orange background. The right side of the frame is filled with white, hand-drawn style line art icons (boots, guitars, bottles), while the left side features large, vertically oriented white text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the central vertical axis with a slight lean to the left.
Vertical text on the left balances the dense line art on the right.
Warm background color provides high contrast for white text and line art.
Horizontal text at the bottom anchors the composition.
coreInvariants: Burnt orange or terracotta background color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, head and shoulders, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large vertical white text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vertical text, move to the subject's face, then scan the line art on the right before settling on the bottom horizontal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is heavily textured with line art and typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for primary typography and line art
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream or pale gold for secondary typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value (white) overlays.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between vertical extra-bold condensed and horizontal bold wide-tracked sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, vertical display feel.
Suitable for the horizontal secondary text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a dark cap and shirt against a solid burnt orange background. On the right side of the background, include white, hand-drawn line art icons of western items like boots, guitars, and bottles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-bold condensed sans-serif text in white, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise along the left edge. Add secondary bold sans-serif text in cream at the bottom center with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text rotated 90 degrees?
Are the line art icons white and hand-drawn in style?
Is the bottom text cream-colored and horizontally oriented?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific brand logos from the cap
Do not use the specific artist name
Do not use the specific song title

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background
avoid: Cluttered overlapping of text and face

postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is legible and correctly oriented.
Ensure the line art does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the color palette matches the burnt orange and white theme.
Confirm the bottom text is centered and clearly visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Burnt Orange Background + White Line Art + Vertical Bold Typography
